subject: Host2Dedicated: validation window & staggered cutover plan - Kestrel Therapeutics
content:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Anna Summers <anna.summers@kestreltx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Host2Dedicated: validation window & staggered cutover plan - Kestrel Therapeutics

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, I sketched a short validation + staggered cutover plan so your team can safely move traffic from the Hosted API to a Dedicated GPU pool without service disruptions. High-level asks:

- Confirm a 72-hour validation window where we mirror 10–20% production traffic to the Dedicated pool.
- Approve the acceptance test cases in the attached validation workbook (throughput, tail-latency, kv-cache hit rates).
- Confirm preferred blackout windows for the final swap (we suggested 02:00–06:00 PT).

Planned milestones:
1) Validation prep (week of Oct 19): baseline capture + smoke tests.
2) Staged ramp (Oct 22–24): 10% → 50% → 100% traffic in scheduled jumps with gating.
3) Post-cutover stabilization (72 hours): monitoring and rollback window.

I've looped in Karthik to add the specific throughput/PT thresholds and Marissa for the operational timeline and PO coordination.

If that timeline looks OK I’ll drop a calendar invite for the validation kickoff and attach the test workbook you can review.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---

>
> Hi all —
>
> Quick technical note on acceptance criteria (I attached a short validation workbook with concrete tests):
>
> - Throughput: sustained 12k tokens/s aggregate across the pool for the 10% mirror window (this maps to your typical peak P95).
> - Latency: P95 generation latency must not increase by more than 20% compared to the Hosted baseline.
> - KV cache warming: achieve >65% prefix hit-rate by end of day 2 for conversational traffic.
> - Error budget: no more than 0.5% 5xxs attributable to the Dedicated pool during validation.
>
> Test plan highlights (see kestrel_validations_v1.xlsx):
> 1) Baseline collection (48 hours) — collect P50/P95/P99 and token rates from Hosted.
> 2) Mirror run (72 hours) — record mirrored requests to Dedicated (no customer-facing rewrite).
> 3) Stress ramp (synthetic) — short burst tests to validate autoscaling policies and graceful throttling.
>
> We will configure a read-only trace export for your security team to ingest; logs can be retained in the console for 30 days as discussed. Cost delta: expect ~7–12% overhead during mirror due to dual processing — detailed estimate in the workbook.
>
> Attaching: kestrel_validations_v1.xlsx (test matrix + thresholds).
>
> —Karthik
> Staff Engineer, Runtime Performance
> karthik.iyer@redwood.com
>
> Attachment: kestrel_validations_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
